verdict.rationale: First-party developer docs show cards being issued programmatically: a Pipedream guide covers bulk-creating virtual cards, and Workato use cases include issuing virtual cards and setting monthly user limits. Spend limits can also be managed through the Budgets API. However, no evidence directly documents a card endpoint, or locking or updating controls on an existing card via the API. Missing for 10: direct card-API endpoint documentation, lock/freeze-card capability, updating card controls, independent hands-on corroboration.
